description: Targeted run `migrate_all.py --module fees` from the repo root (or with the container's default env): the alias resolves to the fees module, the fees ETL child script runs to completion, post-migration SQL (view + triggers) is applied, the summary line is printed, and the process exits 0.
notes: All expected strings, selection semantics, and exit codes are lifted verbatim from scripts/migrate_all.py; nothing hand-invented. Child-script data effects (rows loaded) and summary-JSON filenames are nondeterministic and asserted by rule. Capture against a live legacy run (reachable RavenDB + PostgreSQL + .env + cert) to set validated_against_legacy=true.

environment.working_directory: repository root (migrate_all.py run as `python scripts/migrate_all.py --module fees`)
environment.env_precedence: no PG_*/RAVEN_* variables pre-set in the host environment (so .env values apply)

config.env_file: .env at repo root with PG_HOST, PG_PORT, PG_DB, PG_USER, PG_PASSWORD, RAVEN_URL, RAVEN_DB, RAVEN_CERT_FILE set (values synthesized)

files.sql_dir: student-fee-poc/sql/ containing 01_student_fee_view.sql and 02_trigger.sql (first existing candidate path)
files.postgres_target: empty or partially populated database reachable at PG_* settings

selection.note: alias table not needed for 'fees' (exact registry name); normalization lowercases input

execution.child_invocation: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '<scripts_dir>/migrations/fees_ravendb_to_postgres_migrate.py']) — blocking, sequential, no other module banners present

post_migration_sql.connection: psycopg2 autocommit using PG_HOST/PG_PORT/PG_DB/PG_USER/PG_PASSWORD from resolved env

postgres.note: exact rows loaded depend on live RavenDB contents — assert by count > 0 at capture time, not by literal

artifacts.child_summary_json: validation/migration-summary-<timestamp>.json written by the child (orchestrator neither reads nor aggregates it)

nondeterministic_fields: row counts loaded from RavenDB (live data; assert count > 0 per table at capture)
any timestamps printed inside child output
known_unstated: child stdout details (paging progress, transform logs) belong to the child ETL extraction, not the orchestrator golden

divergent cases (unknown module name, post-SQL exception, partial failure, typo'd flags) are reified as open items in specs/migration/etl-orchestrator.md and deliberately not encoded as passing expectations
